name: Nara (Japan)
description: A red field charged at the centre with a white cherry-blossom outline enclosing the character 奈 with green accents.
history: The flag of Nara bears the city's mon (municipal emblem) in the Japanese civic tradition of a single stylised mark on a plain field.

features.role: Nara municipal emblem — a white cherry-blossom outline enclosing the character 奈 with green accents
features.symbolism: the eight-petalled cherry of the old capital
